company.name: Promeet
company.shortDescription: Promeet provides features that enable creators to monetize their content and earn revenue.
company.description: Promeet offers a seamless way for creators to turn their creative work into income by providing flexible monetization options and supporting diverse content formats.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that allows creators to set up a personalized online store to upload digital content, set prices, and sell directly to their audience with instant blockchain-based payments.
productsAndServices.name: Promeet Store

productsAndServices.description: A payment system that uses blockchain technology to provide creators with immediate, peer-to-peer payouts in stablecoins, bypassing traditional financial intermediaries.
productsAndServices.name: Instant Blockchain Payments

productsAndServices.description: A web3-enabled service allowing creators to host encrypted live video sessions with audience members who pay per session or per minute using cryptocurrency.
productsAndServices.name: Live Video Chatrooms with Monetization

productsAndServices.description: Tools that enable creators to share their Promeet store link across social platforms and websites, with real-time analytics on visits, clicks, and sales to optimize audience engagement.
productsAndServices.name: Content Promotion and Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A referral service that allows users to earn lifetime revenue shares by inviting creators to join Promeet and monetize their content on the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Referral Program (Become a ProMeeter)
